title: Veggie Sausage Bake with Potato, Apple, Sauerkraut & Curry Mayo

steps.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a small bowl and set aside for later use.
Quarter potatoes and place in a medium bowl.
Quarter, core, and large dice apples. Add to the bowl with the potatoes.

Peel, halve, and slice onion lengthwise into ¼-inch thick strips. Add to the bowl along with oil and spices, then stir to combine. Transfer mixture to a large baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until the potatoes are just tender, about 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, place mayo, water, curry powder, and salt in another small bowl. Stir to combine and set aside.
When the potatoes are just tender, remove baking sheet from the oven. Add sausages, drizzle with additional oil, and stir to combine.
Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to cook until sausages are warmed through, 4-5 minutes more (or cook sausages according to package instructions). Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place sauerkraut in a small saucepan. Set over high heat and bring to a simmer, stirring occasionally. Cover and remove from heat.
Add parsley to the baking sheet with the veggies and sausage, then stir to combine.
To serve, divide sausage bake between plates or bowls. Drizzle with curry mayo and top with warm sauerkraut. Enjoy!
